title: Multiply each item
summary: MATLAB: Multiply each item. Change b to [1 2].
introduction: The dot in .* means element-by-element multiplication. Each matching pair is multiplied.

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
.* multiplies corresponding positions: 2 times 4 and 3 times 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Plain * means matrix multiplication, which is a different operation.
